# Operations Analyst

Employer Delta Operations Pty Ltd is a legitimate fictional Australian operations-services employer created solely for this synthetic evaluation.

## Vacancy status

Requisition OA-205 is live and open as at 9:00 AM AEST on 10 September 2026. Applications close 30 September 2026. This is a permanent, full-time professional role based in Melbourne, Victoria.

## Responsibilities

- Prepare weekly operations reports and investigate performance variances.
- Maintain Microsoft Excel dashboards and reconciliations.
- Work with operations leaders to improve reporting quality.

## Mandatory criteria

- At least two years of operations reporting experience.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

These are the complete mandatory criteria; there are no hidden mandatory requirements.

## Australian work rights

Applicants with unrestricted Australian work rights are accepted. The employer does not offer sponsorship for this vacancy; that restriction does not block a candidate who already holds unrestricted work rights and does not require sponsorship.
